paras: Ablepharus eremchenkoi is a species of skink, a lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is native to Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan.
The specific name, eremchenkoi, is in honor of Russian herpetologist Valery Konstantinovich Eremchenko (also published as Jeremčenko).
A. eremchenkoi is found in southern Kazakhstan and northwestern Kyrgyzstan.
The preferred natural habitat of A. eremchenkoi is rocky areas, at altitudes of 2,500–3,300 m (8,200–10,800 ft).
